Each objective was carefully aligned with PPAC’s broader mission to provide world-class performances in a space that is operationally efficient, accessible and future-ready. Among the most transformative achievements of this project was the installation of building-wide WIFI. For the first time in its history, PPAC now has seamless wireless internet coverage across the entire facility, from the auditorium and lobbies to backstage corridors, administrative offices and dressing rooms. This advancement has unlocked new levels of digital readiness and accessibility. Visitors can now benefit from mobile ticketing and real-time program updates, while staff and performers enjoy uninterrupted connectivity essential for daily operations, production management and emergency preparedness. Additionally, this upgrade lays the groundwork for future enhancements such as real-time captioning, assistive listening apps and other digital accessibility tools that will make performances more inclusive for all audiences. Outdated, high-energy lighting fixtures were removed and replaced with modern LED theatrical lighting. This transition dramatically reduces energy consumption, lowers heat output and extends the lifespan of each fixture, resulting in lower operating and maintenance costs. Beyond these practical benefits, the new system offers creative advantages. Programmable LED fixtures expand the range of visual possibilities available to lighting designers, enriching the storytelling potential of every production staged at PPAC. These artistic gains were achieved alongside measurable reductions in electricity usage, directly supporting environmental sustainability goals. Replacing the aging analog infrastructure with a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) solution has streamlined internal communications and improved operational agility. Staff can now access voicemail remotely, coordinate across departments more efficiently and respond more quickly in urgent situations. The new system has proven both cost- effective and reliable, with the added benefit of integrating seamlessly with the building’s upgraded digital infrastructure. Upgraded Phone Administrative Console In addition to lighting and communications, the internal sound system was significantly improved. Focused upgrades were made to the backstage and lobby areas, which are essential zones for both audience experience and behind-the-scenes coordination. Backstage, the new audio system supports clearer communication among technical staff and performers, enhancing performance quality and safety. In the lobby, visitors are now greeted with clear, evenly distributed sound, improving the delivery of pre-show announcements, ambient music and emergency notifications. These enhancements not only elevate the visitor experience but also reinforce PPAC’s commitment to high standards of hospitality and accessibility.
